Near-Aleppo supplies pointed ketiv forms under its general policy for the pointed ketiv. These cases explain particular pointing decisions and the manuscript evidence behind them.

Cases and manuscript evidence

  • Mobile he and the pataḥ
  • Ketiv/qere cases in Daniel
  • Genesis 43:28
  • Avi's lists and near-Aleppo ketiv pointing: 2 Kings, Ezekiel and Ecclesiastes 9:4

The Ecclesiastes 9:4 investigation distinguishes near-Aleppo's adopted pointing from the Leningrad ketiv quoted in MAM's documentation note.
